text.en: Tips and cheers no longer slip under the sticker shelf.
text.lt: Patarimai ir pagyrimai nebelenda po lipdukų lentyna.
text.es: Los consejos y ánimos ya no quedan bajo las pegatinas.

changes: The sticker shelf is now the last row of the game screen instead of floating over it, so nothing can sit under it
The game screen takes the phone's visible height, and fits again whenever the screen or the shelf changes size (safe areas that arrive late, rotation)
Nothing pokes out of the shelf any more, so the fitting no longer shrinks the pictures for nothing (iPhone SE: Expert pictures back to 100 px)
fixes: On iPhone, the coach line under the word could slip under the sticker shelf

text.en: A quick wrong tap gets a tip: read the whole word first.
text.lt: Po skubotos klaidos – patarimas: pirma perskaityk visą žodį.
text.es: Un toque rápido y erróneo trae un consejo: lee la palabra entera.

text.en: Praise for streaks, comebacks, long words and tricky ones.
text.lt: Pagyrimai už serijas, sugrįžimus, ilgus ir sunkius žodžius.
text.es: Elogios por rachas, remontadas, palabras largas y difíciles.

text.en: Two misses or a long pause show the word in parts: Na – mas.
text.lt: Po dviejų klaidų ar ilgos pauzės žodis rodomas dalimis: Na – mas.
text.es: Tras dos fallos o una pausa larga, la palabra por partes: Ga – to.

changes: Coach line under the word, one short sentence at a time (EN, LT, ES), never repeating the last one

Wrong tap: within 1.5 s of the word → read the whole word first; second wrong tap → the word in parts (Na – mas); otherwise → all pictures start with the same letter, read to the end (or say it out loud)
Right first try: 3, 5, 10, 15… in a row; Great comeback after a missed word; a word missed before; a long word (4+ syllables); careful (6 s+) or speedy reading; otherwise sometimes a general cheer
Nothing tapped for 9 s: tap 🔊 to hear it (or the word in parts when read-aloud is off); after 18 s: point at each letter
Two skips in a row: have a go, mistakes are OK; Let's read! at the start
Settings › Game › Tips and cheers (on by default; settings.tips)

text.en: The level and Skip moved to the top bar, so stickers never cover them.
text.lt: Lygis ir „Praleisti“ dabar viršuje – lipdukai jų nebeuždengia.
text.es: El nivel y Saltar están arriba: las pegatinas ya no los tapan.

text.en: The game screen stays put and fits every iPhone, the pictures adjust.
text.lt: Žaidimo ekranas nejuda ir telpa bet kuriame iPhone.
text.es: La pantalla de juego no se mueve y cabe en cualquier iPhone.

changes: The level badge sits under the player's name and Skip is in the top bar; the footer row under the pictures is gone

The game screen is fixed to the screen (no scrolling, no bounce); fitGame() shrinks the picture tiles until everything fits above the sticker shelf, and on small screens hides the hint line and tightens spacing when that gives bigger pictures
Compact top bar: long names end with …; Skip is a round ⏭ button on phones narrower than 414 px
fixes: The sticker shelf covered the level badge and the Skip button, and the game screen could scroll

text.en: After each right answer the picture acts out its word: cars drive, fish swim.
text.lt: Po teisingo atsakymo paveikslėlis suvaidina žodį: mašina nuvažiuoja, žuvis plaukia.
text.es: Tras cada acierto la imagen representa su palabra: el coche arranca, el pez nada.

text.en: Every 5 words right on the first try earn a new sticker.
text.lt: Kas 5 iš pirmo karto atspėti žodžiai – naujas lipdukas.
text.es: Cada 5 palabras acertadas a la primera dan una pegatina nueva.

text.en: Each kid's stickers stay at the bottom of the game. Tap for the album.
text.lt: Vaiko lipdukai visada žaidimo apačioje. Bakstelėk – atsivers albumas.
text.es: Las pegatinas de cada niño están abajo. Toca para ver el álbum.

changes: Funny animations: the right picture leaves its tile and acts out its word (drive, fly, swim, chomp, hop, bloom; dance or spin otherwise) with a speech bubble in the game language; Web Animations, cleaned up after each round; a gentle pop with Reduce Motion
Settings › Game › Funny animations (on by default; settings.fun)
Stickers per player (kid.stickers = { have, shiny, pts }): every N first-try words earn a new sticker from 60; a full album gives shiny ones
Sticker shelf fixed at the bottom of the game with a progress ring; album with the missing stickers as silhouettes; the latest four on each home-screen card
Settings › Rounds › Words for a sticker (2–20, default 5; cfg.stickerEvery)
A new sticker bursts out, flies to the shelf with its own sound, and the next word waits until it has landed

title.es: Primero el aplauso, luego la palabra

text.en: The success sound now plays every time, even with the silent switch on.
text.lt: Sėkmės garsas dabar skamba kiekvieną kartą, net įjungus tylųjį režimą.
text.es: El sonido de acierto suena siempre, incluso con el modo silencio.

text.en: After a right answer the word is read once the success sound has finished.
text.lt: Po teisingo atsakymo žodis ištariamas, kai sėkmės garsas baigiasi.
text.es: Tras acertar, la palabra se lee cuando termina el sonido de acierto.

text.en: Every player hears the word after answering, unless you choose Off.
text.lt: Kiekvienas žaidėjas išgirsta žodį po atsakymo, nebent pasirinksite „Ne“.
text.es: Cada jugador oye la palabra tras responder, salvo que elijas No.

changes: Sound effects (success, right after a miss, wrong, PIN keys) are rendered once as WAV and played through an <audio> element instead of Web Audio, which iOS mutes with the silent switch and can suspend
After answer: the word is spoken 150 ms after the success sound ends (with sounds off, straight away); the AI voice is requested only then too
Read aloud is After answer by default for new players; players still on Off are switched to After answer once (a parent's later choice of Off is kept)
Speech is primed silently inside the Play tap, so words spoken after the success sound aren't blocked by iOS
fixes: The success sound sometimes didn't play, and speech starting at the same moment could cut it off

text.en: Any iPhone voice, or an ✦ OpenAI voice that also reads Lithuanian, with model and style.
text.lt: Bet kuris iPhone balsas arba ✦ OpenAI balsas, skaitantis ir lietuviškai.
text.es: Cualquier voz del iPhone o una ✦ voz de OpenAI que también lee lituano.

title.en: Words as long as you like

text.en: Set the shortest and longest word for each level, in syllables.
text.lt: Nustatykite trumpiausią ir ilgiausią žodį kiekvienam lygiui skiemenimis.
text.es: Elige la palabra más corta y la más larga de cada nivel, en sílabas.

text.en: The listen button now sits under the word, never on top of a letter.
text.lt: Klausymo mygtukas dabar po žodžiu ir niekada neuždengia raidžių.
text.es: El botón de escuchar está bajo la palabra y nunca tapa una letra.

changes: Settings › Listening (app-blueprints · read-aloud 1.0.1): iPhone voice or ✦ AI voice. iPhone: a voice per game language (Automatic picks the best one), the game language's voices first, Female/Male filter, speed and pitch. AI (OpenAI key): speech model (gpt-4o-mini-tts, tts-1-hd, tts-1 or any your key can use), voice with Female/Male filter, How it should sound, speed; Test the voice

The AI voice names the word's language in its instructions, so Lithuanian and Spanish words are pronounced as such; each word's audio is kept on the phone and paid for once per voice, model, speed and style; usage counted as Read aloud
If the AI voice fails, the word is read by the iPhone voice
Settings › Rounds: shortest and longest word for Beginner (1–2) and Expert (3–6), 1–6 syllables; level cards, book-word status and the AI coach follow the ranges
The 🔊 button is in its own row under the word card, larger
fixes: The 🔊 button covered the last letters of the word

title.es: Cada palabra del libro se juega

text.en: Book words with a rare first letter play too, with pictures from nearby letters.
text.lt: Ir retos raidės žodžiai žaidžiami, su paveikslėliais iš gretimų raidžių.
text.es: Las palabras con una letra rara también se juegan, con dibujos de letras cercanas.

text.en: Before adding, each word says if it will play, and if not, why.
text.lt: Prieš pridedant kiekvienas žodis parodo, ar bus žaidžiamas, ir kodėl ne.
text.es: Antes de añadir, cada palabra dice si se jugará y, si no, por qué.

text.en: Each book shows how many of its words are in rounds; tap to see every word.
text.lt: Prie kiekvienos knygos matyti, kiek žodžių žaidžiama; paspaudus – visi žodžiai.
text.es: Cada libro muestra cuántas palabras están en juego; toca para verlas todas.

changes: Words from books and the AI coach always play: when few words share their first letter, the other pictures come from the nearest letters (Z → Ž…), same letter first. Built-in words keep the strict same-letter rule

Review sheet: each word shows its level (🐣/🦉) and, under the list, "3 of 4 words in rounds" with the reason for every word that won't play yet (book words Off, another language, no player at that level) or gets nearby-letter pictures
Parent zone › Words from books: "12 of 15 words in rounds" per book, and Show the words lists every word with its status
fixes: Book words starting with a letter that has few game words (Lithuanian Z, I, H, Ū…) were saved but never shown in a round

text.en: Take a photo and From photos open the iPhone's picker on top of the game.
text.lt: „Fotografuoti“ ir „Iš nuotraukų“ atidaro iPhone pasirinkimą virš žaidimo.
text.es: Hacer foto y De fotos abren el selector del iPhone sobre el juego.

text.en: Words from books is the first card in the parent zone, highlighted with AI on.
text.lt: „Žodžiai iš knygų“ – pirma tėvų zonos kortelė, paryškinta, kai DI įjungtas.
text.es: Palabras de libros es la primera tarjeta de la zona de padres, resaltada con IA.

text.en: Skipped words no longer count as hard, so new words keep coming.
text.lt: Praleisti žodžiai nebelaikomi sunkiais, todėl nauji žodžiai vis ateina.
text.es: Las palabras saltadas ya no cuentan como difíciles, así llegan palabras nuevas.

changes: Words from books is the first card in the parent zone; with an AI key it has an accent border and a ✦ AI badge

The book photo is now picked by the game page with the iPhone's own picker (camera for Take a photo, library for From photos), shrunk on the phone to 1568 px and handed to the Scriptable side directly instead of through Scriptable's photo picker
fixes: Take a photo and From photos did nothing: Scriptable's photo picker opened behind the full-screen game, out of reach
Smart word order: a word that was only skipped counts as a new word, not a hard one, so skipping doesn't crowd out new words or the really hard ones

text.en: Snap a page and AI turns its words into new picture rounds.
text.lt: Nufotografuokite puslapį, o DI jo žodžius pavers naujais raundais.
text.es: Haz una foto de una página y la IA convierte sus palabras en rondas.

text.en: Hard words come back more often, and an AI coach picks what to practise next.
text.lt: Sunkūs žodžiai kartojasi dažniau, o DI treneris parenka, ką praktikuoti toliau.
text.es: Las palabras difíciles vuelven más y un entrenador IA elige qué practicar.

text.en: Each kid can hear the word when it appears or after answering.
text.lt: Kiekvienas vaikas gali išgirsti žodį, kai jis pasirodo, arba po atsakymo.
text.es: Cada niño puede oír la palabra al aparecer o tras responder.

changes: Words from books (parent zone): take a photo of a page or pick one from Photos; AI reads it and suggests picturable nouns in dictionary form, split into syllables, each with an emoji; the parent reviews and names the source before the words join the game
Book word sources listed in the parent zone with two-tap delete; Settings › Learning › Book words in the game: Mixed in, First or Off
Smart word order (Settings › Learning, on by default, no AI): per-kid, per-word spaced repetition; hard words come back more often, mastered ones rarely

AI coach per kid: a short tip for the parent, up to 8 focus words and up to 12 new words aimed at the letters the kid finds hard; runs after every 40 answered words (What AI does) or on Ask the AI coach; sends word progress only, never names

Read words aloud per kid (Off, When shown, After answer) with a 🔊 replay button on the word card; the iPhone's voices, Scriptable Speech as a fallback; Settings › Learning says whether a voice for the game's language is installed
AI settings (app-blueprints · ai-configuration 1.0.0) in Settings › Learning: Claude or OpenAI, keys only in the iOS Keychain, model menu, Test connection, token usage by feature, model and day
Anonymous usage (if on): app_open now says whether an AI key is set (ai_key)
fixes: Hard words are counted from real mistakes only, so skipping words doesn't slow down new words

text.en: If you agree, Reading Stars sends anonymous counts of the features you use. Nothing else.
text.lt: Jei sutiksite, Reading Stars siųs anoniminius naudojamų funkcijų skaičius. Nieko daugiau.
text.es: Si aceptas, Reading Stars envía recuentos anónimos de las funciones que usas. Nada más.

text.en: A random ID made on your phone, never your content, names or accounts.
text.lt: Atsitiktinis telefone sukurtas ID, niekada jūsų turinys, vardai ar paskyros.
text.es: Un ID aleatorio creado en tu teléfono, nunca tu contenido, nombres ni cuentas.

text.en: Settings › Privacy turns it on or off, and Send test shows what happened.
text.lt: Nustatymai › Privatumas įjungia arba išjungia, o „Siųsti bandymą“ parodo rezultatą.
text.es: Ajustes › Privacidad lo activa o desactiva, y «Enviar prueba» muestra el resultado.

changes: Anonymous usage analytics (app-blueprints · usage-analytics 1.1.0): opt-in, anonymous counts to PostHog's US cloud, with a one-time question and Settings › Privacy (switch and Send test)
Events: app_open (layout, theme, language, players), round_finished (level, correct on first try), payout_made, player_added, app_updated
Never sent: names, avatars, words, tokens, money or the PIN

text.en: Each Settings section now sits in its own card, so you can tell where it starts and ends.
text.lt: Kiekviena nustatymų sekcija dabar savo kortelėje, todėl aišku, kur ji prasideda ir baigiasi.
text.es: Cada sección de Ajustes está ahora en su propia tarjeta: se ve dónde empieza y dónde acaba.

text.en: Section names are small grey capitals, so they no longer look like settings.
text.lt: Sekcijų pavadinimai – mažos pilkos didžiosios raidės, todėl nebeatrodo kaip nustatymai.
text.es: Los nombres de sección son pequeñas mayúsculas en gris y ya no parecen ajustes.

text.en: The cards follow your colours, text size and layout, light or dark.
text.lt: Kortelės prisitaiko prie jūsų spalvų, teksto dydžio ir išdėstymo, šviesiai ar tamsiai.
text.es: Las tarjetas siguen tus colores, el tamaño del texto y el diseño, claro u oscuro.

changes: Settings (app-blueprints · settings 1.1.0): each section's rows sit in one card, with a thin border and a slightly lighter background, under a small muted uppercase heading
The changed-count line and a section's explanation sit outside the cards; Built with is a card too

title.es: Adiós a la pantalla en blanco

text.en: Reading Stars opens straight to its star, even from the widget or after a few quick taps.
text.lt: Reading Stars iš karto atsidaro su žvaigžde, net iš valdiklio ar po kelių greitų paspaudimų.
text.es: Reading Stars se abre directamente con su estrella, incluso desde el widget o tras varios toques rápidos.

text.en: If iCloud is slow, the game waits for your players and never saves an empty game over them.
text.lt: Jei iCloud lėtas, žaidimas palaukia žaidėjų ir niekada neįrašo tuščio žaidimo vietoj jų.
text.es: Si iCloud va lento, el juego espera a tus jugadores y nunca guarda una partida vacía encima.

text.en: Settings › Updates › Start-up log shows what happened the last times the game opened.
text.lt: Nustatymai › Atnaujinimai › Paleidimo žurnalas rodo, kas vyko paskutinius kartus atidarant žaidimą.
text.es: Ajustes › Actualizaciones › Registro de inicio muestra qué pasó las últimas veces que se abrió el juego.

changes: Safe start-up (app-blueprints recipe safe-startup 1.1.0): an empty window in the launch screen colour comes up first, the launch screen is built inside it, and the players are read and handed over after that, with a "Loading your players…" placeholder until they arrive
Only settings.json is read before the window; data.json (and its backup) is read in loadData(), and every iCloud read gives up after 10 s instead of waiting forever
The players reach the page in pieces (window.__parts, then window.__boot) instead of inside the page itself, and every message to the page has a time limit
One window at a time: quick taps on the widget wait at most 1.5 s for an earlier window, then open anyway
The update check starts 3.5 s after the first screen and the widget icon download 6 s after it, so neither competes with opening
If opening stalls for 25 s or fails, the page says so in the game's language and shows the last lines of the start-up log
Settings › Updates › Start-up log (behind the parent PIN) shows the last 40 lines: timings, the number of players and the names of late or started-fresh files only, never money, budgets or the PIN
The one-time move of letter style, currency and sounds from data.json into settings.json now happens after the data is read, and only if it was read

A data.json that arrived damaged no longer stops the game from saving: it is copied aside as data.broken-<time>.json, the backup takes its place as before, and if the backup is damaged too the game starts fresh, says so in the game's language and saves again (safe-startup 1.1.0)
Only a file that iCloud didn't deliver (or that couldn't be read at all) is left unsaved for the run
fixes: Opening Reading Stars from its widget, after several quick taps, or with slow or offline iCloud could leave a blank screen
If iCloud hadn't delivered data.json in time, closing the game could save an empty game over the players' tokens and points; now nothing is saved until the data has been read

title.es: Estrellas en tu pantalla de inicio

text.en: See the top reader and everyone's stars on the Home Screen without opening the game.
text.lt: Matyk pirmaujantį skaitytoją ir visų žvaigždes pagrindiniame ekrane, neatidaręs žaidimo.
text.es: Ve al líder y las estrellas de todos en la pantalla de inicio sin abrir el juego.

text.en: Type a player's name in the widget's Parameter to show just their tokens.
text.lt: Įrašyk žaidėjo vardą valdiklio parametre ir matysi tik jo žetonus.
text.es: Escribe el nombre de un jugador en el parámetro del widget para ver solo sus fichas.

text.en: Works offline and on the Lock Screen, and never shows money, budgets or the PIN.
text.lt: Veikia be interneto ir užrakinimo ekrane, niekada nerodo pinigų, biudžetų ar PIN.
text.es: Funciona sin conexión y en la pantalla bloqueada; nunca muestra dinero ni el PIN.

changes: Home Screen and Lock Screen widget in the shared frame of the other apps (widgets blueprint 1.0.0): the Reading Stars star and name, the top reader with ⭐ points and 🪙 tokens to spend, the other players ranked as on the leaderboard (medium and large) and the number of players
Widget Parameter: a player's name shows only that player, with their tokens as the big number and their place on the leaderboard
Lock Screen: "⭐ Ema leads with 120" inline, the leader's points in the circle, the leaderboard line in the rectangle
The widget follows the game's language (Lithuanian, English, Spanish) and shows only names, avatars, points and tokens: never token values, budgets, payouts or the PIN
The widget reads a small snapshot saved after every round, payout and player change, so it works offline; data older than 12 hours shows "⟳ Updated …" in amber
Parent zone › Settings › Widget: how often iOS is asked to refresh it (30 min) and when it counts as out of date (720 min)
Built with lists the widgets blueprint
fixes: A widget pointing at Reading Stars no longer shows Scriptable's error ("Presenting a configured web view is not supported"): the game's start-up now runs only when the game is opened

text.en: A big yellow star with a sparkle and a teal reading line.
text.lt: Didelė geltona žvaigždė su žybsniu ir žalsva skaitymo linija.
text.es: Una gran estrella amarilla con un destello y una línea de lectura turquesa.

text.en: The star pops in and the tagline appears for about 2 seconds; tap to skip.
text.lt: Žvaigždė iššoka ir apie 2 sekundes rodomas šūkis; paspausk, kad praleistum.
text.es: La estrella aparece y el lema se muestra unos 2 segundos; toca para saltarlo.

text.en: The star sits on top of the home screen and in the README.
text.lt: Žvaigždė puikuojasi pradžios ekrano viršuje ir README.
text.es: La estrella está arriba en la pantalla principal y en el README.

changes: New Reading Stars logo (the big star): docs/logo.svg and a 1024 px app icon, docs/icon-1024.png

Launch screen shown for 2.4 s with a short animation and the tagline in the game's language (Read. Match. Shine. / Skaityk. Rask. Spindėk. / Lee. Elige. Brilla.); tap to skip; still with Reduce Motion; follows the shared launch-screen blueprint 1.0.0
The logo replaces the book and star emoji at the top of the home screen, and heads the README
Built with lists the launch-screen blueprint

text.en: Six colour themes for parents to choose, including a calm night sky.
text.lt: Šešios spalvų temos tėvams pasirinkti, tarp jų ramus naktinis dangus.
text.es: Seis temas de color para que elijan los padres, con un cielo nocturno tranquilo.

title.es: Texto más grande o más pequeño

text.en: Text size and layout to fit every reader; the game word still fills the card.
text.lt: Teksto dydis ir išdėstymas kiekvienam skaitytojui; žaidimo žodis vis tiek užpildo kortelę.
text.es: Tamaño de texto y diseño para cada lector; la palabra del juego sigue llenando la tarjeta.

title.es: Ajustes de padres en un solo lugar

text.en: Letter style, sounds, money, PIN, round sizes and updates, behind the PIN.
text.lt: Raidžių stilius, garsai, pinigai, PIN, raundų dydis ir atnaujinimai – už PIN kodo.
text.es: Estilo de letra, sonidos, dinero, PIN, tamaño de rondas y actualizaciones, tras el PIN.

changes: New Settings sheet in the parent zone (sliders icon, behind the PIN): Appearance, Game, Money, Parent, Updates with Check now, Rounds and Built with; changes apply at once, in Lithuanian, English or Spanish
Appearance shared with the other apps: six palettes plus Auto (the bright Ink look stays the default), Comfortable, Compact or Tiny layout, four text sizes, rounded or serif headings
Night and Slate palettes give the game a night sky; picture tiles, syllable colours and the copybook word card stay the same in every palette
Tiny layout: one line per player on the leaderboard and in the parent zone; tap a player for the details. The game screen is unchanged
Pictures per round can be set: Beginner 2–4 (3), Expert 3–5 (5)
Letter style, currency and sounds move from data.json to settings.json in the same folder, automatically; players, tokens, budgets and the PIN stay in data.json
Built with: the blueprints this app follows, with links to read them

text.en: The game tells you when a new version is out, and waits two days if you tap Later.
text.lt: Žaidimas praneša apie naują versiją, o paspaudus „Vėliau“ palaukia dvi dienas.
text.es: El juego avisa cuando hay versión nueva y espera dos días si tocas Más tarde.

text.en: Update right from the game. No need to run the installer again.
text.lt: Atnaujink tiesiai žaidime, diegimo scenarijaus nebereikia.
text.es: Actualiza desde el juego, sin volver a usar el instalador.

text.en: Every update shows its three best features before you install it.
text.lt: Prieš diegiant matysi tris geriausias atnaujinimo naujoves.
text.es: Cada actualización muestra sus tres mejores novedades antes de instalarla.

changes: Update check on start, with an update sheet in Lithuanian, English and Spanish
Update now downloads the new script over the running one; Later hides the offer for 2 days
The update sheet appears only on the home screen, never during a round
Version number on the home screen and in the parent zone
CONFIG.CHECK_UPDATES switch to turn update checks off
releases.json, CHANGELOG.md, tools/changelog.js and docs/RELEASING.md

text.en: Big syllable-split words with 3 or 5 pictures that all start with the same letter.
text.lt: Dideli žodžiai skiemenimis ir 3 ar 5 paveikslėliai iš tos pačios raidės.
text.es: Palabras grandes por sílabas con 3 o 5 dibujos que empiezan por la misma letra.

text.en: +1 for a correct read, −1 for a wrong tap, shown as pocket money in a big wallet.
text.lt: +1 už teisingą, −1 už klaidą, o vertė pinigais matoma didelėje piniginėje.
text.es: +1 por acertar, −1 por fallar, y su valor en dinero en una gran cartera.

text.en: Set each kid's token value and hidden budget, top up and pay out behind a PIN.
text.lt: Su PIN kodu nustatykite žetono vertę, slaptą biudžetą, papildykite ir išmokėkite.
text.es: Con PIN: valor de ficha, presupuesto oculto, recargas y canjes por niño.

changes: Picture-and-word reading game for Scriptable with Lithuanian, English and Spanish (about 190–200 words each)
Beginner (ages 4–6): 1–2 syllables, 3 pictures; Expert (ages 9–11): 3–6 syllables, 5 pictures
All pictures in a round start with the word's first letter
Kid profiles with name, level and avatar; leaderboard with podium and all-time points
+1 token for a correct first try, −1 for each wrong tap (never below 0)
Big animated wallet showing tokens and their money value
Parent zone behind a 4-digit PIN: per-kid token value, hidden budget, top-ups, payouts and history
Kids are told to ask for a top-up when the budget can't cover their tokens
Word letter style, currency and sound settings
One-line installer (install.js)
fixes: Black screen on start caused by the old save loop
Parent zone could not open after adding a player in the same session
